svg.title: Encoded size against UTF-8, by language (UDHR documents)
svg.desc: Bar chart of the encoded size of UDHR documents in Steno, SCSU, BOCU-1 and UTF-16 as a percentage of UTF-8, per language. The same numbers are in the table UDHR, Documents, under Size by Language.
svg.text: Encoded size against UTF-8, by language (UDHR documents)
Size as a percentage of the UTF-8 size; smaller is better. 100% is UTF-8.
Compressors are not shown: the smallest is 38% to 74% smaller than Steno in each language (Size by Language, UDHR, Documents). SCSU sizes are those of ICU's encoder.
